a\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.PowerShell_8wekyb3d8bbwe\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import csv, json, re
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from datetime import datetime
p=Path('.')
def br(s): return Decimal(s.strip().replace('.', '').replace(',', '.'))
def rounded(v): return v.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
with (p/'finance/chart_of_accounts.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
    accounts={r['account']:r['pnl_line'] for r in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter=';')}
months=[f'2026-{m:02}' for m in range(1,7)]
base=['revenue','cogs','sales_marketing','rnd','ga']
values={k:{m:Decimal(0) for m in months} for k in base}
count=0
with (p/'finance/ledger.csv').open(encoding='utf-8-sig',newline='') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f,delimiter=';'):
        d=datetime.strptime(r['date'],'%d/%m/%Y'); m=d.strftime('%Y-%m')
        line=accounts[r['account']]
        amount=br(r['amount'])
        if m not in months: continue
        count+=1
        if line=='financial': continue
        if line not in values: raise ValueError('Unexpected P&L mapping')
        values[line][m]+=amount if line=='revenue' else -amount
for k in ['gross_profit','gross_margin_pct','ebitda']: values[k]={}
for m in months:
    gp=values['revenue'][m]-values['cogs'][m]
    values['gross_profit'][m]=gp
    values['gross_margin_pct'][m]=gp/values['revenue'][m]*100 if values['revenue'][m] else Decimal(0)
    values['ebitda'][m]=gp-sum(values[k][m] for k in ['sales_marketing','rnd','ga'])
order=['revenue','cogs','gross_profit','gross_margin_pct','sales_marketing','rnd','ga','ebitda']
with (p/'pnl.csv').open('w',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\\n'); w.writerow(['line']+months)
    for k in order: w.writerow([k]+[format(rounded(values[k][m]),'.2f') for m in months])
burn=-sum(values['ebitda'][m] for m in months[3:])/3
cash_text=(p/'finance/cash_balance.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
cash=br(re.search(r'R\\"'$'"\\s*([\\d.,]+)',cash_text).group(1))
runway=(cash/burn).quantize(Decimal('0.1'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
(p/'runway.json').write_text('{\\n  \"burn_avg_3m\": '+format(rounded(burn),'.2f')+',\\n  \"runway_months\": '+format(runway,'.1f')+'\\n}\\n',encoding='utf-8')
with (p/'pnl.csv').open(newline='') as f:
    rows=list(csv.reader(f))
assert rows[0]==['line']+months and [r[0] for r in rows[1:]]==order
assert all(len(r)==7 for r in rows)
assert json.loads((p/'runway.json').read_text())['runway_months']==float(runway)
print(f'Validated {count} half-year ledger entries; outputs written.')
print((p/'pnl.csv').read_text())
print((p/'runway.json').read_text())
